title: Cosmist Manifesto
content:
Plato Lovelace is an archivist at Alien-Warehouse.

The Russian Cosmism Circle was founded in 2024 in New York City.

Post-doomer Solar Maximum:

Join us tonight in NYC: 7pm at 77 Fulton Street, New York, NY 10038

Readings on freedom and flourishing, utopia, dystopia, eutopia and liberty from artists and thinkers: @trueloveandworldpeace, @ray_toyota and @johan.michalove.

Music by: @alicedoescomputermusic, @replacedbyimages, @42live23, @2008band and @tv_embrace (DJ).

Oko Farms @okofarms, New York City’s only publicly accessible aquaponics farm, will table the event.

Flyer: @context_understander_. Image 2 credit: “Garnet (Longchang, Guangdong Province, China)” by James St. John, CC BY 2.0.

We are cosmists residing in the New England Upland at the Schist island at the mouth of the Hudson.

We stand south of the Minetta Brook, Beekman’s Swamp and Lispenard Meadows, we stand upon the slope of the Golden Hill, above a drowned bluff.

Below our feet glitters sillimanite-muscovite-biotite-kyanite schist and gneiss interlayered with tourmaline-garnet-plagioclase-biotite-quartz schist and gneiss with black amphibolite layers.

Many of us either sleep on the schist or cross the East River every night and sleep on the Harbor Hill Moraine, created by glacial debris dropped by the retreating Laurentide ice sheet of the Wisconsin glaciation roughly 18,000 to 22,000 years ago.

That is where we are located on Earth.
In Homo sapiens history, we are 81 solar revolutions into the Atomic Age.

We are living in the twilight between the Anthropocene and the Xenocene.

We are carbon-based mammals, living among nascent silicon machines.

The credos we proclaim with pink flesh vocal cords, hidden inside warm tender throats are:

The cosmos is ordered and has meaning

We order and give it meaning through consciousness

Marx raised consciousness around class

Class consciousness is necessary, but not sufficient

We need more consciousnesses

Consciousness of our cosmic condition and cosmic place

We need true post-Copernican consciousness

Geo-consciousness, solar-consciousness and cosmos-consciousness

We are a planet that exists in relation to our star, the Sun

Life, wealth and human activity on Earth are solar-dependent

We are at the mercy of our sun and star

Climate change must be understood as a solar crisis

We find ourselves, as a planet and as a species, in a state of profound and urgent crisis

The biggest crises of all are those that wrap themselves around the planet

We call these crises “pandemics” from the Greek “pandemos”, meaning “pertaining to all people.”

Faced with pandemos crises, we need pandemos politics: politics pertaining to all people

We must all, with urgency, engage ourselves in pandemos politics

We must all, with crystal-clear consciousness, see which ideologies, illusions and delusions divide and exploit and subjugate us today and hinder pandemos politics

The delusion that a person’s skin color should determine one’s worth

The delusion that gender, sex and sexuality should determine what a person is permitted to do and with whom

The delusion that the political borders one is born within should determine where one can live, travel and work on this planet

The delusion that the Global North is superior to and separate from the Global South

The delusion that individual nation-states and national governments can and should face planetary crises alone

The delusion that, despite this Earth belonging to us all, it is permissible for the wealthy to hoard vast and terrifying amounts of natural and earthly resources, which they did not create

We need consciousness that reveals to us how those divisions and false consciousnesses prevent necessary planetary unity

Pandemos politics starts with the “demos”: the people

We seek planetary unity as if standing before a plummeting asteroid

But we will not achieve planetary unity until we achieve geo-consciousness, solar-consciousness and cosmos-consciousness

We will not achieve planetary unity without true democracy and true equality and true freedom for all

The demos is situated in the cosmos

We are not separate from the cosmos

We are not separate from our planet

We are carbon. We are mammals. We are humans.

We need water. We need sunlight. We need air

We need—for now—planet Earth as our home

We demand abundance

We reject scarcity and retreat

The only correct response to the threat of dystopia

is the dream of eutopia: “the good place”

And the first step towards eutopia is democracy

Rule by the people for the people

In pursuit of life

Ever more life

And against death, extinction and genocide—always
author: Do Not Research
